title: Two Sum
problem_statement: Given an integer array and a target, return indices of two different elements whose values add to the target.

solution.approach: Store visited values and their indices in a hash map. For every value, check whether its complement has already been seen.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
problem_statement: Given daily stock prices, find the maximum profit obtainable using one buy followed by one sell.

solution.approach: Track the minimum price seen so far and calculate the best profit at every position.

title: Valid Parentheses
problem_statement: Determine whether every opening bracket in a string is closed by the correct bracket in the correct order.

solution.approach: Push opening brackets onto a stack and match each closing bracket with the current stack top.

title: Contains Duplicate
problem_statement: Return true if any integer appears at least twice in the input array.

solution.approach: Insert values into a set and return true whenever a value is already present.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problem_statement: Find the length of the longest substring containing no repeated characters.

solution.approach: Use a sliding window and remember the latest position of each character.

title: Product of Array Except Self
problem_statement: Return an array where each position contains the product of all input elements except the element at that position without using division.

solution.approach: Store prefix products in the output array and multiply them by suffix products during a reverse traversal.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
problem_statement: Return the k values that occur most frequently in an integer array.

solution.approach: Count frequencies using a hash map and use a heap or bucket sort to obtain the k most frequent values.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
problem_statement: Count the number of continuous subarrays whose sum equals k.

solution.approach: Maintain a running prefix sum and count previously seen prefix sums equal to current_sum minus k.

title: Trapping Rain Water
problem_statement: Given bar heights, calculate the total amount of rain water trapped between the bars.

solution.approach: Use two pointers while maintaining maximum heights seen from the left and right.

title: Minimum Window Substring
problem_statement: Find the smallest substring of s containing every character required by t including repeated occurrences.

solution.approach: Expand a sliding window until all requirements are satisfied, then shrink it while maintaining validity.

title: Edit Distance
problem_statement: Return the minimum number of insertions, deletions, and replacements needed to transform one string into another.

solution.approach: Use dynamic programming where dp[i][j] represents the minimum operations needed for the first i and j characters.

title: Word Ladder
problem_statement: Find the length of the shortest transformation sequence from a begin word to an end word where one character may change at each step and every transformed word must exist in the dictionary.

solution.approach: Treat words as graph nodes and perform breadth-first search because BFS discovers the shortest transformation sequence.

title: Binary Search
problem_statement: Find the index of a target value in a sorted integer array or return -1 when it does not exist.

solution.approach: Repeatedly discard half of the sorted search range.

title: Valid Anagram
problem_statement: Determine whether two strings contain exactly the same characters with exactly the same frequencies.

solution.approach: Compare character frequency maps for both strings.

title: Majority Element
problem_statement: Return the value appearing more than half of the time in the array.

solution.approach: Use the Boyer-Moore voting algorithm to maintain a candidate and counter.

title: Missing Number
problem_statement: An array contains distinct numbers from 0 through n with exactly one value missing. Return that missing value.

solution.approach: Use XOR or compare the expected arithmetic sum with the actual sum.

title: Group Anagrams
problem_statement: Group strings that contain the same characters with identical frequencies.

solution.approach: Use a canonical representation such as sorted characters or frequency counts as the dictionary key.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problem_statement: Search for a target in a sorted array that has been rotated and return its index or -1.

solution.approach: Use modified binary search and determine which half remains sorted during each iteration.

title: Course Schedule
problem_statement: Given courses and prerequisite relationships, determine whether every course can eventually be completed.

solution.approach: Build a directed graph and detect whether it contains a cycle using DFS or topological sorting.

title: Rotting Oranges
problem_statement: Every minute rotten oranges infect adjacent fresh oranges. Return the minimum time until no fresh orange remains or -1 when impossible.

solution.approach: Run multi-source BFS starting from every initially rotten orange.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
problem_statement: Return the median value after conceptually combining two sorted arrays without fully merging them.

solution.approach: Binary search the smaller array to find a partition where values on the left side do not exceed values on the right side.

title: Longest Increasing Path in Matrix
problem_statement: Find the maximum length of a path through adjacent matrix cells where every next value is strictly larger.

solution.approach: Run DFS from each cell and memoize the longest increasing path starting from that cell.

title: Regular Expression Matching
problem_statement: Determine whether a string completely matches a pattern where dot matches any character and star means zero or more occurrences of the preceding element.

solution.approach: Use dynamic programming over positions in the string and pattern while handling normal, dot, and star transitions.

title: Distinct Subsequences
problem_statement: Count how many distinct subsequences of source equal target.

solution.approach: Use dynamic programming where each state counts ways to form a target prefix from a source prefix.

title: Reverse String
problem_statement: Return the characters of a string in reverse order.

solution.approach: Use two pointers moving inward or traverse the string backward.

title: Palindrome Number
problem_statement: Determine whether an integer reads the same forward and backward.

solution.approach: Reverse the digits or compare symmetrical digits without converting the entire value.

title: Integer Square Root
problem_statement: Return the floor of the square root of a non-negative integer.

solution.approach: Binary search possible integer roots while avoiding floating-point calculations.

title: Climbing Stairs
problem_statement: You may climb one or two steps at a time. Return how many distinct ways exist to reach step n.

solution.approach: The number of ways follows the Fibonacci recurrence using the previous two results.

title: Spiral Matrix
problem_statement: Return all matrix elements in clockwise spiral order.

solution.approach: Maintain top, bottom, left, and right boundaries and shrink them after traversing each side.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
problem_statement: If any matrix element is zero, make its entire row and column zero and return the resulting matrix.

solution.approach: Use the first row and first column as markers to achieve constant additional space.

title: House Robber
problem_statement: Find the maximum money obtainable from houses arranged in a row when adjacent houses cannot both be robbed.

solution.approach: At each house choose between skipping it or adding its value to the best solution two positions earlier.

title: Word Break
problem_statement: Determine whether a string can be segmented into a sequence of dictionary words.

solution.approach: Use dynamic programming where dp[i] records whether the first i characters can be segmented.

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
problem_statement: Given histogram bar heights, return the largest rectangular area that can be formed using consecutive bars.

solution.approach: Use a monotonic increasing stack to determine the maximal width available to each height.

title: Maximal Rectangle
problem_statement: Return the area of the largest rectangle containing only ones in a binary matrix.

solution.approach: Treat each row as the base of a histogram and solve a largest-rectangle-in-histogram problem.

title: Burst Balloons
problem_statement: Each balloon gives coins based on its value and its current neighbors when burst. Return the maximum obtainable coins.

solution.approach: Use interval dynamic programming and choose which balloon is burst last inside each interval.

title: Wildcard Matching
problem_statement: Match an entire string against a pattern where question mark matches one character and star matches any sequence.

solution.approach: Use dynamic programming over string and pattern positions while handling star as either empty or consuming another character.

title: Move Zeroes
problem_statement: Move every zero to the end while preserving the relative order of non-zero values and return the resulting array.

solution.approach: Use one pointer for the next non-zero destination and compact non-zero values before filling remaining positions with zero.

title: Single Number
problem_statement: Every value appears exactly twice except one value. Return the value that appears once.

solution.approach: XOR every value because identical values cancel each other.

title: Fibonacci Number
problem_statement: Return the nth Fibonacci number where F0 is zero and F1 is one.

solution.approach: Iteratively keep only the previous two Fibonacci values.

title: Counting Bits
problem_statement: For every integer from zero through n, return how many one bits appear in its binary representation.

solution.approach: Use the relation bits[i] equals bits[i shifted right by one] plus the least significant bit.

title: Container With Most Water
problem_statement: Choose two vertical lines that together with the x-axis contain the maximum amount of water.

solution.approach: Start with pointers at both ends and repeatedly move the pointer with the smaller height.

title: 3Sum
problem_statement: Return all unique triples of integers whose sum equals zero.

solution.approach: Sort the array, fix one value, and use two pointers to search for complementary pairs while skipping duplicates.

title: Daily Temperatures
problem_statement: For every daily temperature return how many days must pass before a warmer temperature occurs, or zero if none occurs.

solution.approach: Use a decreasing monotonic stack containing indices of temperatures still waiting for a warmer day.

title: Sort Colors
problem_statement: Sort an array containing only zero, one, and two without using a general-purpose sorting algorithm.

solution.approach: Use the Dutch national flag algorithm with low, current, and high pointers.

title: N Queens Count
problem_statement: Return the number of ways n queens can be placed on an n by n chessboard such that no queens attack each other.

solution.approach: Place one queen row by row while tracking occupied columns and diagonals and backtrack after each choice.

title: Merge K Sorted Lists
problem_statement: Given several sorted lists represented as arrays, merge them into one sorted array.

solution.approach: Push the first value from every non-empty list into a min heap and repeatedly advance the list whose value was removed.

title: First Missing Positive
problem_statement: Find the smallest positive integer that does not occur in an unsorted integer array using constant additional space.

solution.approach: Place every value x in its natural position x minus one whenever possible, then find the first mismatching position.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
problem_statement: Return the maximum element in every contiguous window of size k.

solution.approach: Maintain a decreasing deque of useful indices so the front always stores the current window maximum.

title: Intersection of Two Arrays
problem_statement: Return the unique values that appear in both arrays.

solution.approach: Convert one array to a set and collect common values while avoiding duplicates.

title: Longest Common Prefix
problem_statement: Return the longest prefix shared by every string in an array.

solution.approach: Compare characters column by column or shrink a candidate prefix until every string starts with it.

title: Power of Two
problem_statement: Determine whether a positive integer is exactly a power of two.

solution.approach: A positive power of two has one set bit, so n AND n-minus-one equals zero.

title: Roman to Integer
problem_statement: Convert a valid Roman numeral string to its integer value.

solution.approach: Scan numeral values and subtract a value when it is smaller than the following numeral; otherwise add it.

title: Gas Station
problem_statement: Given gas available and travel cost around a circular route, return a starting station allowing one complete circuit or -1.

solution.approach: If total gas is sufficient, greedily reset the candidate start whenever the running balance becomes negative.

title: Insert Interval
problem_statement: Insert a new interval into sorted non-overlapping intervals and merge every overlap.

solution.approach: Append intervals before the new interval, merge overlaps, then append intervals occurring after it.

title: Task Scheduler
problem_statement: Given CPU tasks and a cooldown n between identical task types, return the minimum execution intervals required.

solution.approach: Use frequency counts and schedule high-frequency tasks while respecting cooldown slots.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
problem_statement: Return the length of the longest sequence of consecutive integers in an unsorted array.

solution.approach: Put values in a set and begin counting only from values that do not have a predecessor.

title: Combination Sum
problem_statement: Return every unique combination of candidate values whose repeated use can sum exactly to target.

solution.approach: Backtrack over candidate choices while tracking the remaining target and preventing reordered duplicates.

title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problem_statement: Determine whether an integer array can be divided into two subsets having equal total sums.

solution.approach: If the total sum is even, solve a subset-sum problem targeting half of the total.

title: Minimum Path Sum
problem_statement: Starting at the upper-left matrix cell and moving only right or down, return the minimum possible sum on a path to the lower-right cell.

solution.approach: Use dynamic programming where each cell stores its value plus the smaller reachable cost from above or left.

title: Maximum Product Subarray
problem_statement: Return the maximum product obtainable from a non-empty contiguous subarray.

solution.approach: Track both the maximum and minimum products ending at each position because multiplication by a negative value swaps their roles.
